Loved that thing more than life itself&hellip; said when he got outta the joint he'd go dig it up from where he'd stashed it out past the mollusk arches and that the Ayrou 'would never get it back,' whatever that meant.|A former Thonner prisoner|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
The '''mollusk arches''' were a location on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]]. At one point, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Vcikas]] buried a statue sought after by members of the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at a site situated past the [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] arches, with a group of [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]] later learning about the deed.

==Description==
The mollusk arches were a site on [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]<ref name="Tessent" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and was covered in shallow [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and [[Water/Legends|seas]] that were broken by chains of sandy islands.<ref name="Endor">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

==History==
{{RPG|"[[Race for the Tessent]]"}}
At some point after Thonner's [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]]<ref name="Tessent" /> in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]<ref name="Endor" /> and during the planet's use as a [[Prison/Legends|penal]] colony by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a group of incarcerated Ayrou criminals hid there a statue sought after by their fellow Ayrou. The [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] planned to escape and retrieve the statue, but it eventually fell into the hands of another incarcerated individual, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Vcikas]]. He became very attached to the artifact and buried it at a site past the [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] arches, being likewise determined to retrieve it once he left prison&mdash;which he did end up doing by escaping at one point at least sixteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after Thonner's colonization.<ref name="Tessent" />

Eventually, a fellow [[Unidentified Thonnerman|escapee]] relayed the story of their and Vcikas' escape to a listener, mentioning the mollusk arches. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Thonner was visited by a group of [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]] who, on account of the tale, believed that the statue Vcikas had possessed was, in fact, one of the two [[Alsakan Tessent|valuable]] [[Ayrou Tessent|artifacts]] known as the [[Tessent]]s.<ref name="Tessent" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Race_for_the_Tessent_G9.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The mollusk arches were introduced in the roleplaying adventure "Race for the Tessent."]]
The mollusk arches were mentioned in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Race for the Tessent]]," which was published for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Tessent" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref>

Instead of featuring a set plot, "Race for the Tessent" presents several settings in the Moddell [[Sector/Legends|sector]], Thonner being one of them, that the player characters may visit during their search for the artifacts known as the Tessents. For each of the settings, the adventure also suggests possible circumstances for a Tessent being hidden there. Assuming that as much of the non-contradictory information presented in the adventure as possible is [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, this article assumes that the Alsakan Tessent and the Ayrou Tessent were instead hidden on the planets [[Ast Kikorie/Legends|Ast Kikorie]] and [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]], respectively.<ref name="Tessent" />
